findings.title: Separate ordinary ListBox identity proof from scoped tree/canvas generation proof
findings.quote: List/canvas/tree native identities, generation and scope are checked against owner publication by the bound fixture.
findings.evidence: selectionListCompleted checks ordinary native host/row identities, values/selected/disabled metadata, clipped frames and stability across its three proposals. It does not test GridScope or GridGeneration. Tree/canvas predicates separately require completed scoped incarnation/generation and owner/publication agreement. The collective sentence overstates what is checked for the ordinary list.
findings.recommendation: State the ListBox identity/value/clipping checks separately, and scope generation/incarnation/namespace proof specifically to the tree and named canvas paths.

findings.title: Describe fixture clipboard/preferences declarations without claiming a global disable
findings.quote: Clipboard access and preference changes are disabled and reported false by the fixture; global OS state is outside this observation.
findings.evidence: main.go explicitly disables only the fixture window geometry saver; clipboard_access/preferences_changed false are literal fixture report declarations, not a general OS clipboard/preferences disable or global observation. The final clause limits global observation but does not make the claimed general disable implemented.
findings.recommendation: Say the fixture requests no general clipboard or OS preference changes, explicitly name disabled fixture geometry persistence, and retain that global OS state is not observed.
